title: User function body with local-variable write — Tier 4.3 pass-4 item A
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= nand2(a, b);` where the user function body writes an intermediate local `v := x and z;` and returns `not v`. Runtime already correct via DeferredUserFunction. Tier 4.3 pass-4 item A: the synth-time inliner accepts an Operation prefix that writes locals declared in the function, registers each write as a scope alias so subsequent reads (including the terminal return) pick up the driver net, and emits AND + NOT cells instead of an opaque UserFunction constant. Bench passes on VCD equality regardless of which synth path took hold; the inlining is verified separately via the schematic viewer / audit-synth.
